title: Academy kernel-only migration with existing OIDC; source preparation, not deployment ready
description: The top level validates the frozen technical manifest. $defs contains separate strict approval, immutable freeze, future root evidence index, exclusion and stopped-observation contracts. Runtime also validates cross-field equality, real bytes, role, freshness and custody. Never fill hashes with example values. Inputs.v4 requires a role-bound closed runtime baseline and reviewed candidate_baseline.py helper hash. Historical v2/v3 manifests are rejected; previous D122 identifies recovery only. The fixed transition is [a0011_oidc_login_states] to [0031_rate_limit_buckets,a0011_oidc_login_states]; existing OIDC catalog observation does not claim past migration acceptance. Receipt.v2 and EvidenceIndex.v2 are mandatory. No runtime inputs or approval are created. Maintenance authority source-only binding: execution v5 requires pinned maintenance component and helper; promotion v4 and acceptance v3 reject old manifests. Actual observations/retained receipts and fresh current fences are required; no generated approval or placeholder runtime evidence. Sender census successor: execution v6, promotion v5, freeze v2 pins protected authority scope; v2 complete receipts require full current coverage, empty gaps, strict source bundles and genuine authority. Full eight-domain and remote adapters are presently unsupported and refuse; this schema creates no completed instance. Campaign census v7 requires fixed process/discovery/transport helper hashes and protected static v2 peer profile references. Profiles contain no future observations; live nonce requests bind dynamic source/bootstrap/seed-index bytes. Seven domain adapters remain unavailable and cannot create full coverage. No runtime instance or approval is created.

exclusion.description: STRICT full four-authority exclusion unchanged: all zero senders/unaccounted authorities and concrete fences mandatory. Additionally actual observation START must follow BOTH successful original stop completion times and receipt hashes. Every outside/unresolved pre-inventory finding from both hosts requires an actual post-stop bound proof, never a fabricated fence or presumed absence. Readiness-only quiescence cannot satisfy this schema.

preQuiescenceInventory.description: Truthful root-custody observation, not global exclusion or ready=true. Observed pre-candidate web and CLI units ignore new mailgate. Enumerate actual active PID/startticks and pending fixed stop/drain actions; outside findings/coverage may be active or unknown. No authority to stop extra actors. Runtime compares actual initial unit/PID observations to this receipt and original baseline; strict post-both-stop exclusion requires concrete resolution of every finding.

preStopLabIdleObservation.description: Actual fixed helper output retained as quiesce observations.pre_stop_lab_idle: web before any timer/primary downtime; lab immediately before old worker stop while it can still drain. Root verifies exact full before revisions, readonly app_admin/row_security-off/visibility and ALL-tenant queued/claimed0 plus present-or-unknown0. Not a host-quiescence or sender-exclusion claim. Nonzero refuses; runtime destruction/reaping forbidden.
